item.name: Steak
item.source: Redeem codes, daily login rewards, Lucky Blocks, Food Stand, and Traveling Merchant
item.bestUse: Spend on animals with the best base BPS before feeding low-value catches.
item.cardSummary: Feeds one animal and increases its weight, which raises its BPS output.

item.name: Bone
item.source: Redeem codes, Lucky Blocks, Food Stand, and daily login rewards
item.bestUse: Carry a stack when farming Forest Wolf or regular Wolf routes.
item.cardSummary: Placed on the ground to lure Wolves in the Forest biome.

item.name: Prime Feed
item.source: Lucky Blocks, Traveling Merchant, and event rewards
item.bestUse: Save for pets with long-term pen value instead of early common animals.
item.cardSummary: A stronger feed item that gives more weight and BPS than regular Steak.

item.name: Enriched Feed
item.source: Lucky Blocks, Traveling Merchant, and high-tier event rewards
item.bestUse: Hold for your strongest keeper pets because supply is limited.
item.cardSummary: The highest listed food tier for a single weight and BPS boost.

item.name: Bloodmoon Grape
item.source: Bloodmoon weather map spawns, Bloodmoon Spin Wheel, and Bloodmoon Lucky Blocks
item.bestUse: Use on a pet with strong base BPS so the mutation multiplier matters.
item.chance: Bloodbound is listed as a 2.5x mutation
item.cardSummary: Fed to a pet during Bloodmoon progression for a chance at the Bloodbound mutation.

item.name: Cosmic Fruit
item.source: Meteor impact sites during Cosmic Shower and rare Lucky Block drops
item.bestUse: Collect quickly during the weather window before impact-site rewards disappear.
item.chance: Cosmic is listed as a 1.5x mutation
item.cardSummary: Collected at meteor impact sites during Cosmic Shower weather and fed to pets for the Cosmic route.

item.name: Chocolate Heart
item.source: Valentine's weather event map spawns and event reward routes
item.bestUse: Use during the event on pets that are valuable enough to keep after the event ends.
item.chance: Lovestruck is listed as a 2.25x mutation
item.cardSummary: A Valentine's event consumable that feeds into the Lovestruck mutation route.

item.name: Mutation Diffuser
item.source: Buildings section of the Lassos and Food Shop
item.bestUse: Clear a low-value mutation only when you have a better mutation route ready.
item.cardSummary: A placed machine that removes a selected unwanted mutation from a pet.

item.name: Standard Lucky Block
item.source: Volcanic-mutated pen pets, daily login rewards, and Traveling Merchant
item.bestUse: Save for a strong luck window when you are chasing totems or better bulk rewards.
item.cardSummary: A general reward block with food, early totems, coins, and low-rarity pet rewards in its listed pool.

item.name: Bloodmoon Lucky Block
item.source: Bloodmoon Spin Wheel and Boss Hydra defeat rewards
item.bestUse: Open when you need Bloodmoon-route rewards, but do not spend weather luck boosts expecting this pool to improve.
item.cardSummary: A Bloodmoon reward block with Bloodmoon consumables, pets, cosmetics, coins, and food in its listed pool.

item.name: Legendary Lucky Block
item.source: Volcanic-mutated pets and high-tier event completion
item.bestUse: Hold for a major luck window unless you urgently need feed or totems.
item.cardSummary: A higher-tier reward block with rare food, rare totems, better pets, coins, and a rare lasso reward in its listed pool.

item.name: Rain Totem
item.source: Lucky Blocks, daily login rewards, and Exclusive Shop
item.bestUse: Useful early when you want an easier weather window without spending rarer totems.
item.cardSummary: Triggers Rainy Weather for early luck and rain-route farming.

item.name: Thunderstorm Totem
item.source: Lucky Blocks, daily login rewards, and Exclusive Shop
item.bestUse: Use when you can watch Dragon Island and have pen pets worth upgrading.
item.cardSummary: Triggers Thunderstorm Weather for Charged mutation attempts and Lightning Dragon farming.

item.name: Sandstorm Totem
item.bestUse: Save for a focused desert farming route instead of using during normal catch loops.
item.cardSummary: Triggers Sandstorm Weather for desert-route rare spawns.

item.name: Cosmic Totem
item.source: Legendary Lucky Blocks and Exclusive Shop
item.bestUse: Use when your pen and Sky Island route are both ready for the short weather window.
item.cardSummary: Triggers Cosmic Shower Weather for Cosmic mutation and Cosmic Griffin routes.

item.name: Aurora Totem
item.source: Legendary Lucky Blocks and Exclusive Shop
item.bestUse: Save for serious hatching, catching, or reward-opening sessions.
item.cardSummary: Triggers Aurora Borealis Weather for a large luck boost.

item.name: Blizzard Totem
item.source: Lucky Blocks, daily login rewards, and Exclusive Shop
item.bestUse: Use when you are ready to farm snow-route pets during the weather window.
item.cardSummary: Triggers Blizzard Weather for Snow Biome farming.
